en.headline: Hong Kong beat Brunei 2-0 to reach ASEAN Cup final
en.dek: Chan Siu-kwan and Matt Orr scored at Kai Tak Sports Park as the team finished Group A with two wins and will face Cambodia on Saturday.
body: Hong Kong beat Brunei 2-0 at Kai Tak Sports Park on Wednesday night to win Group A of the FIFA ASEAN Cup second-tier tournament and reach Saturday's final against Cambodia. Chan Siu-kwan headed the opener after the break and Matt Orr finished a stoppage-time cross from Everton Camargo in front of 20,116 spectators.

The side had already beaten Laos 4-0 and needed only to avoid a heavy defeat. Hong Kong rotated heavily, keeping just Juninho and Beto among the previous starters. The team dominated the first half but went in scoreless after several chances were saved or sent over.

A Brunei player was sent off early in the second half after a video review. Chan scored from a right-wing cross around the hour, and Orr hit the bar twice before converting in added time. The final is scheduled for 3 October at the same stadium.

zh.headline: 港隊2比0勝汶萊 東盟盃決賽鬥柬埔寨
zh.dek: 陳肇鈞下半場頭槌破網，安永佳補時鎖定勝局，港隊兩戰全勝以A組首名晉級，周六再戰啟德對柬埔寨。
body: 中國香港周三晚在啟德體育園主場館以2比0擊敗汶萊，奪得國際足協東盟盃第二級別賽事A組首名，晉級十月三日決賽對柬埔寨。陳肇鈞換邊後接應傳中頭槌先開紀錄，安永佳補時接應艾華頓傳中射入，入場觀眾20,116人。
港隊首戰已4比0擊敗老撾，本場保持不敗即可出線。教練團大幅輪換，與上仗相比僅祖連奴及比提繼續正選。上半場港隊攻勢較多，但多次射門被門將救出或高出，半場0比0。
下半場初段汶萊球員因粗暴犯規經視像助理裁判檢視後被紅牌趕出場。約一小時左右陳肇鈞頂入領先，其後安永佳兩度頂中楣，直至補時鎖定2比0。決賽同樣安排在啟德主場館舉行。
